dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: A crisis? I see this as the opportunity of a lifetime!

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: If there is any adventurer who does not get their blood up at this, surely they fail as an adventurer!

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: Once the time is right, I must take Jack and the others out to see the world. And thanks to this incident, our adventure teams can be expanded a little, yes?

dialogues.speaker: Cyrus
dialogues.text: And as for the dragon... well, there isn't anything that cannot be conquered with perseverance, is there?
